rec.name: Model View Toggle (Worn-Image Switch) for Collection Pages
rec.status: Built — launched as A/B test (extended to bundle collection)

what.text: A toggle on collection pages, labelled 'TRAGEBILDER' (worn / on-model images). When switched on, product cards in the grid show on-model photos instead of the default product shots. The feature was first built as an A/B test on the bestseller collection page. It was then extended to the bundle collection page (/collections/bundle), and the existing test was updated to cover both pages.

why.text: Seeing jewelry worn lets shoppers judge size, fit and style, which is hard to do from flat product shots. This lowers uncertainty and makes the product feel more real and emotional. It also lets shoppers choose the view they prefer, which reduces friction while browsing and can raise click-through to the PDP and add-to-cart rate. The model-view and toggle mechanics are inferred from the toggle label and ticket title, not from a detailed spec.

how.text: Add a switch at the top right of the collection grid toolbar, next to the filters or sort area. On toggle, swap each product card's primary image for its on-model image (for example a second media item or a metafield image). Optionally persist the choice in session storage. Roll it out to the bestseller and bundle collection templates and run it via an A/B tool (Ablyft), with variant B showing the model view. The exact implementation (default state, image source, persistence) is not documented in the ticket.

items: Default state (on/off) — the screenshot shows it off
Which collections/templates it is active on (bestseller, bundle)
Source of the on-model image per product (assumed)
A/B test targeting: variant B only

dependencies.text: Each product needs an on-model image, likely a dedicated media item or metafield (assumed, not stated). Requires an A/B testing tool (Ablyft preview URLs are referenced). Requires collection templates for bestseller and bundle.
